finding.id_encoding: base64, identical to trace_spans ID columns

notes: The generated MCP APM catalog reference omitted links, but actual project compilation and a bounded historical ID-only response confirmed the column and type.
Empty results from projections reusing trace_id/span_id as SELECT aliases were not treated as absence evidence; final IDs were checked with qualified source columns and distinct output aliases.
The fixed historical ten-minute sample is schema evidence only; it does not prove current production acceptance, completeness, or business success.

content.text: {"query":{"kind":"HogQLQuery","query":"SELECT toTypeName(links) AS links_type, length(links) AS link_count FROM posthog.trace_spans WHERE trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('77cad3a99b9e154b27aaa2c6c0226283')) AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:00:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:10:00', 'UTC') ORDER BY timestamp, uuid LIMIT 1"},"results":"links_type|link_count\nArray(String)|0","__formatted_results_override":"links_type|link_count\nArray(String)|0"}

{"query":{"kind":"HogQLQuery","query":"SELECT lower(hex(tryBase64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id, lower(hex(tryBase64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id, arrayMap(link -> isValidJSON(link), links) AS link_json_valid, arrayMap(link -> JSONExtractKeys(link), links) AS link_json_keys FROM posthog.trace_spans WHERE trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('77cad3a99b9e154b27aaa2c6c0226283')) AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:00:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:10:00', 'UTC') AND length(links) > 0 ORDER BY timestamp, uuid LIMIT 3"},"results":"trace_id|span_id|link_json_valid|link_json_keys","__formatted_results_override":"trace_id|span_id|link_json_valid|link_json_keys"}

{"query":{"kind":"HogQLQuery","query":"SELECT lower(hex(tryBase64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id, lower(hex(tryBase64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id, arrayMap(link -> isValidJSON(link), links) AS link_json_valid, arrayMap(link -> JSONExtractKeys(link), links) AS link_json_keys FROM posthog.trace_spans WHERE service_name = 'mikka-web' AND name = 'workflow.execute' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:00:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:10:00', 'UTC') AND length(links) > 0 ORDER BY timestamp, uuid LIMIT 1"},"results":"trace_id|span_id|link_json_valid|link_json_keys","__formatted_results_override":"trace_id|span_id|link_json_valid|link_json_keys"}

{"query":{"kind":"HogQLQuery","query":"SELECT lower(hex(tryBase64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id, lower(hex(tryBase64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id, arrayMap(link -> isValidJSON(link), links) AS link_json_valid, arrayMap(link -> JSONExtractKeys(link), links) AS link_json_keys FROM posthog.trace_spans WHERE service_name = 'mikka-web' AND (name = 'workflow.execute' OR name LIKE 'workflow.execute %') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:00:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:10:00', 'UTC') AND length(links) > 0 ORDER BY timestamp, uuid LIMIT 1"},"results":"trace_id|span_id|link_json_valid|link_json_keys\nd800cdfe653e7cb1dd4f60c079008f82|5f6975f48cd14aac|[1]|[['attributes', 'dropped_attributes_count', 'flags', 'span_id', 'trace_id', 'trace_state']]","__formatted_results_override":"trace_id|span_id|link_json_valid|link_json_keys\nd800cdfe653e7cb1dd4f60c079008f82|5f6975f48cd14aac|[1]|[['attributes', 'dropped_attributes_count', 'flags', 'span_id', 'trace_id', 'trace_state']]"}

{"query":{"kind":"HogQLQuery","query":"SELECT lower(hex(tryBase64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id, lower(hex(tryBase64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id, arrayMap(link -> if(match(JSONExtractString(link, 'trace_id'), '^([0-9a-fA-F]{32}|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{22}==)$'), JSONExtractString(link, 'trace_id'), 'unrecognized'), links) AS link_trace_ids, arrayMap(link -> if(match(JSONExtractString(link, 'span_id'), '^([0-9a-fA-F]{16}|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{11}=)$'), JSONExtractString(link, 'span_id'), 'unrecognized'), links) AS link_span_ids FROM posthog.trace_spans WHERE trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('d800cdfe653e7cb1dd4f60c079008f82')) AND span_id = base64Encode(unhex('5f6975f48cd14aac')) AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:00:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-06 20:10:00', 'UTC') ORDER BY timestamp, uuid LIMIT 1"},"results":"trace_id|span_id|link_trace_ids|link_span_ids","__formatted_results_override":"trace_id|span_id|link_trace_ids|link_span_ids"}
